items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I remember my parents taking me to see the Glenn Miller orchestra... [INTERVIEWEE] That’s right.

ctx.x: and different bands that came to town featuring Easton’s young trumpet player. Anyway then I think maybe you know this too, in that band that I played with that was Maynard and Buddy Childers and Conte Candoli — all the heavyweights you know — Bob Cooper, Art Pepper, all those guys. And I saw those guys get on that band bus and man I was drooling. I said I’ve got to get on that band bus someday. So I wanted to be a lead trumpet with that band someday. And it came to pass.

I know what you’re saying. I remember my parents taking me to see the Glenn Miller orchestra. It was long after Glenn was gone of course, but I stood in front of the sax section and said, “I want to do that, I want to do that” without knowing of course what anything about what the life was like.
